value.rationale: The object is a published cosine-memory map with a natural measurement inversion problem. Its weighted inverse-sheet sum controls how much physical planar area is transported to any bounded observation region, a motivated invariant distinct from merely counting inverses. The exact logarithmic coefficient cancels de while the inverse-count coefficient depends on de, and yields a sharp non-sigma-finiteness obstruction for unrestricted area transport. This cannot be inferred from the existing forward hidden-attractor plots or a different map’s unweighted inverse count. No downstream cryptographic or forward attractor claim is needed.
